title: Light palak paneer with chickpeas
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Blanch the spinach for 1 minute, cool in cold water and blend smoothly with a little water.
Dice the paneer, fry it in 1 tsp oil until golden and set aside.
Chop the onion, garlic, ginger and chilli, fry with the cumin in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, add the spinach purée, chickpeas and garam masala and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the yoghurt and paneer, season with salt and serve with rice.
